summary.en: Monday pre-market focus on FOMC rate decision anticipation with Middle East oil supply disruption dominating headlines. Energy sector leadership from Friday may persist but inflation concerns from sustained elevated oil prices complicate Fed policy narrative. Investors await clarity on whether oil price shock anchors higher yields and impacts Fed's disinflation timeline.
summary.zh: 周一盘前焦点为美联储利率决策预期，中东石油供应中断主导头条。能源板块从周五的领先地位可能延续，但持续高企油价引发的通胀担忧使美联储政策叙事复杂化。投资者等待油价冲击是否固化收益率更高并影响美联储降通胀时间表。

title.en: FOMC Decision Tomorrow: Oil Price Shock Tests Fed Disinflation Commitment
title.zh: 明天 FOMC 决策：油价冲击考验美联储降通胀承诺

impact.en: Tomorrow's FOMC decision critical. Sustained high oil prices ($85-90 Brent) provide supply-driven inflation evidence that could justify rate hike but also signal growth headwinds.
impact.zh: 明天 FOMC 决策关键。持续高油价（布伦特 85-90 美元）提供供应驱动通胀证据，可能证明加息理由但也显示增长逆风。

macroRisk.en: MEDIUM-HIGH - Fed must balance inflation fight with economic stability. Oil supply shock complicates policy independence from external price drivers.
macroRisk.zh: 中高风险 - 美联储必须在通胀战斗与经济稳定间平衡。油价供应冲击使政策独立于外部价格驱动复杂化。

title.en: Oil Prices Near $85-90: Middle East Supply Disruption Sustains Geopolitical Premium
title.zh: 油价接近 85-90 美元：中东供应中断维持地缘政治溢价

impact.en: Yanbu refinery disruption and Saudi pipeline issues keep Brent elevated. Oil price transmission to consumer prices tests Fed patience. Transportation costs rising pressures retail/margins.
impact.zh: 延布炼油厂中断和沙特管道问题使布伦特维持高位。油价向消费者价格传导考验美联储耐心。运输成本上升施压零售/利润率。

macroRisk.en: HIGH - Oil inflation persistence risks anchoring core PCE expectations upward, complicating Fed's disinflation path and rate cut timing.
macroRisk.zh: 高风险 - 油价通胀持续性风险使核心 PCE 预期向上锚定，复杂化美联储降通胀路径和降息时机。

title.en: 10Y Treasury Yields Press Higher on Oil Inflation Concerns, Range-Bound at ~4.0%
title.zh: 10 年期美债收益率因油价通胀担忧而施高，在约 4.0% 区间震荡

impact.en: Oil-driven supply shock elevates yield curve, pressuring rate-sensitive sectors. Fed's credibility on inflation anchoring under test as external price drivers exceed control.
impact.zh: 供应冲击抬高收益率曲线，施压利率敏感板块。美联储在通胀锚定可信度受外部价格驱动超出控制时测试。

macroRisk.en: MEDIUM - Elevated 10Y yields pressure duration. Fed communication must clarify inflation vs growth tradeoff in current environment.
macroRisk.zh: 中风险 - 高企 10 年期收益率施压久期。美联储沟通必须在当前环境下澄清通胀与增长权衡。

title.en: Gold Holds Above $2,400 on Geopolitical Safe-Haven Despite Yield Headwinds
title.zh: 黄金尽管收益率逆风，在地缘政治避险下维持在 2,400 美元上方

impact.en: Gold prices elevated on geopolitical risks despite USD strength. Safe-haven demand supports precious metals as inflation hedge and store of value amid supply disruption uncertainty.
impact.zh: 尽管美元强劲，金价因地缘政治风险而高位。避险需求支持贵金属作为通胀保值和储值工具，因供应中断不确定性。

macroRisk.en: MEDIUM - Gold benefits from uncertainty but high yields limit upside. Strong USD and Fed hawkish stance cap appreciation potential.
macroRisk.zh: 中风险 - 黄金受益于不确定性但高收益率限制上行。强劲美元和美联储鹰派立场限制升值潜力。

title.en: AI Sector Resilience Tested: Supply Chain Risks vs Strong Chip Demand
title.zh: AI 板块韧性受考验：供应链风险与强劲芯片需求

impact.en: Semiconductor demand remains strong but Middle East supply disruptions pose operational risks. Taiwan-related geopolitical tensions could impact global fab capacity.
impact.zh: 半导体需求保持强劲但中东供应中断构成运营风险。台湾相关地缘政治紧张可能影响全球晶圆产能。

macroRisk.en: LOW-MEDIUM - AI fundamentals strong but geopolitical risk premium impacts longer-term planning. China demand remains key growth driver.
macroRisk.zh: 低中风险 - AI 基本面强劲但地缘政治风险溢价影响长期规划。中国需求保持关键增长驱动。

title.en: Asian Markets Mixed Overnight: Energy Leaders Offset Regional Weakness
title.zh: 亚洲市场隔夜分化：能源领先抵消区域疲软

impact.en: Japan/Nikkei and Korea/KOSPI showed some weakness but energy-related sectors outperformed. Asian pre-market may see energy-led strength carry over.
impact.zh: 日本日经和韩国 Kospi 显示一些疲软但能源相关板块超额表现。亚洲盘前可能看到能源驱动的强势延续。

macroRisk.en: MEDIUM - Regional sentiment cautious ahead of US open. Any broader Asian decline could spill over to US equity risk.
macroRisk.zh: 中风险 - 区域情绪在美国开盘前谨慎。任何广泛亚洲下跌可能波及美国股权风险。

title.en: Dollar Index Stable as Yield Curve Steepens on Inflation Fears
title.zh: 美元指数在通胀恐惧中收益率曲线陡峭时保持稳定

impact.en: DXY stable to slightly higher with yield curve steepening. Safe-haven flows support USD strength vs emerging markets but multinationals face FX headwinds.
impact.zh: DXY 在收益率曲线陡峭时保持稳定到略有上涨。避险资金支持美元对新兴市场强势但跨国公司面临外汇逆风。

macroRisk.en: MEDIUM - Strong USD pressures EM and import-heavy sectors. Fed rate decision will determine whether dollar strength persists or moderates.
macroRisk.zh: 中风险 - 强劲美元施压新兴市场和重进口板块。美联储利率决策将决定美元强势是否持续或缓和。

ai.en: AI chip demand resilient but Middle East supply chain disruptions pose operational risks. Taiwan geopolitical tensions could impact global fab capacity planning.
ai.zh: AI 芯片需求有韧性但中东供应链中断构成运营风险。台湾地缘政治紧张可能影响全球晶圆产能规划。

semiconductor.en: Semiconductors resilient with China demand support. Supply chain disruptions from Middle East may affect manufacturing capacity but fundamentals remain strong.
semiconductor.zh: 半导体在中国需求支持下有韧性。中东供应链中断可能影响制造能力但基本面保持强劲。

bigTech.en: Big Tech overshadowed by macro headlines today. Cloud revenue resilient but rate-sensitive positioning concerns investors as oil inflation complicates Fed narrative.
bigTech.zh: 大科技被宏观头条掩盖。云收入有韧性但利率敏感定位使投资者担忧，因油价通胀复杂化美联储叙事。

energy.en: ENERGY SECTOR LEADING - Brent near $85-90 multi-month highs. Middle East supply disruption (Yanbu pipeline) sustaining elevated oil prices. Major beneficiary of geopolitical premium.
energy.zh: 能源板块领先 - 布伦特接近 85-90 美元数月高点。中东供应中断（延布管道）维持高油价。地缘政治溢价主要受益者。

ev.en: EV sector faces pressure from higher oil prices reducing demand elasticity. Chinese EV competition intensifies but policy support mixed across regions amid macro headwinds.
ev.zh: 电动车板块面临高油价降低需求弹性压力。中国电动车竞争加剧但政策支持在不同地区混合受宏观逆风影响。

market.en: Broad market likely defensive pre-FOMC with energy leadership offsetting tech weakness. Geopolitical oil shock dominates headline risk. Expect volatility around tomorrow's Fed decision.
market.zh: 大盘在 FOMC 前可能防御，能源领导抵消科技疲软。地缘政治油价冲击主导头条风险。预计围绕明天美联储决策波动。

preciousMetals.en: Gold prices elevated on geopolitical safe-haven demand and inflation hedge appeal. Strong USD and higher yields limit upside but supply disruption uncertainty provides support.
preciousMetals.zh: 金价因地缘政治避险需求和抗通胀保值吸引力而高位。强劲美元和较高收益率限制上行但供应中断不确定性提供支持。

oil.en: Brent WTI near $85-90. Yanbu refinery disruption and Saudi supply issues key supply shock maintaining elevated levels. Geopolitical premium embedded in pricing remains stable.
oil.zh: 布伦特 WTI 接近 85-90 美元。延布炼油厂中断和沙特供应问题是关键供应冲击维持高位。定价中地缘政治溢价保持稳定。

futures.en: S&P/Nasdaq/Dow futures likely slightly lower to mixed with Asian sessions declining. Expect energy-related sectors offsetting broader weakness pre-market. Volatility elevated ahead of FOMC.
futures.zh: 标普/纳指/道琼斯期货可能略有下跌到分化，亚洲时段下跌。预计能源相关板块抵消盘前广泛疲软。FOMC 前波动率高。

treasury10Y.en: 10Y yields elevated at ~4.0% driven by oil price inflation shock. Expect continuation of 3.8-4.2% range as investors process supply risk implications vs Fed hike expectations.
treasury10Y.zh: 10 年期收益率因油价通胀冲击而升至约 4.0%。随着投资者处理供应风险影响与美联储加息预期，预计继续 3.8-4.2% 区间。

dxy.en: Dollar index stable to slightly higher with yield curve steepening on inflation fears. Safe-haven flows support USD strength vs emerging market currencies.
dxy.zh: 美元指数在通胀恐惧中收益率曲线陡峭时保持稳定到略有上涨。避险资金支持美元对新兴市场货币的强势。

oil.en: WTI/Brent near $85-90 range. Yanbu disruption and Saudi supply issues support higher levels. Geopolitical premium embedded in pricing remains stable amid Middle East tensions.
oil.zh: WTI/布伦特接近 85-90 美元范围。延布中断和沙特供应问题支撑更高水平。中东紧张局势中定价中的地缘政治溢价保持稳定。

keyRisk.en: Tomorrow's FOMC decision critical. Oil price inflation persistence could anchor higher yields and derail disinflation expectations. Fed must balance inflation fight with economic stability.
keyRisk.zh: 明天美联储决策关键。油价通胀持续性可能锚定较高收益率并毁掉降通胀预期。美联储必须在通胀战斗与经济稳定间平衡。

note.en: Mixed sentiment driven by geopolitical oil supply shock (inflation risks) vs FOMC decision anticipation. Energy sector outperformance may offset broader tech weakness pre-market. Recommend defensive positioning until Fed clarity on rate policy and inflation trajectory.
note.zh: 混合情绪由地缘政治油价供应冲击（通胀风险）与美联储决策预期驱动。能源板块超额表现可能在盘前抵消广泛科技疲软。建议在对美联储利率政策和通胀轨迹明朗化之前采取防御性配置。
